title: fix: remove error when HTTP QUERY request has empty body
body:
The `FST_ERR_ROUTE_MISSING_CONTENT` error doesn't seem to align with [the spec](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc10008#section-2).

> Servers MUST fail the request if the Content-Type request field ([[HTTP](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9110)], [Section 8.3](https://rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110#section-8.3)) is missing or is inconsistent with the request content.

This part doesn't say anything about request body being empty.
Inconsistency between `Content-Type` and request body (i.e. if media type itself does not allow empty content) should be handled by content parser rather than here.
